title: Brinell Hardness Number - BHN
description: Calculator for Brinell Hardness Number (BHN) based on the load applied and the diameter of the steel ball and impression. The BHN is calculated using the formula: BHN = 2P / (πD(D - √(D² - d²)))

outputs.label: Brinell Hardness Number
outputs.formula: 2 * inputs.load_kg / (3.14159265 * inputs.ball_diameter * (inputs.ball_diameter - sqrt(inputs.ball_diameter * inputs.ball_diameter - inputs.impression_diameter * inputs.impression_diameter)))
